DEFINE INSTRUMENT tas_rebuilt(
  kI = 1.55,
  kF = 1.55,
  wVS = 0.03,
  tilt = 0.0,
  SA = -1.0,
  A3 = 0.0,
  A4 = 70.0,
  L3 = 1.0,
  L4 = 1.0,
  Mono_flatswitch = 0
)

DECLARE
%{
  double m_n = 1.67493e-27;
  double hbar = 1.05457e-34;
  double meV_to_SI = 1.6022e-22;
  double SI_to_meV = 6.2414e+21;
  double MGUIDE = 3.2;
  double W_para = 0.0025;
  double R0_para = 0.99;
  double Qc_para = 0.0217;
  double alpha_para = 3.9;
  double LGUIDE_1 = 18.65;
  double LGUIDE_2 = 17.8;
  double rho_AV = 1.23;
  double L1 = 1.75;
  double L2 = 2.2;

  int SM;
  int SS;
  double DM;
  double DA;
  double A1;
  double A2;
  double RMH;
  double RMV;
  double A5;
  double A6;
  double RAH;
  double RAV;
  double lambdaI;
  double EI;
  double SelFreq;
  double dlambdaI;
  double l_min;
  double l_max;
  double e_min;
  double e_max;
  double beta_guide_1;
  double beta_guide_2;
  double s_guide_1;
  double s_guide_2;
  double A5_ang;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  SM = -1;
  SS = 1;
  DM = 3.355;
  DA = 3.355;
  
  A1 = SM * RAD2DEG * asin(PI / (DM * kI));
  A2 = 2 * A1;
  RMH = (L1 + L2) / (2 * sin(A1 * DEG2RAD));
  if (Mono_flatswitch == 1) {
    RMH = 0.0;
  }
  RMV = (L1 + L2) * sin(A1 * DEG2RAD);
  
  printf("monochromator angles are:\n A1=%7.3f, A2=%7.3f [deg]\n", A1, A2);
  printf("radius of curvature RMH=%7.3f [m]\nradius of curvature RMV=%7.3f [m] \n", RMH, RMV);
  printf("sample angles are:\n A3=%7.3f, A4=%7.3f [deg]\n", A3, A4);
  
  A5 = SA * RAD2DEG * asin(PI / (DA * kF));
  A6 = 2 * A5;
  RAH = (L3 + L4) / (2 * sin(A5 * DEG2RAD));
  RAV = SA * 1.0 / rho_AV;
  
  printf("analyser angles are:\n A5=%7.3f, A6=%7.3f [deg]\n", A5, A6);
  printf("radius of curvature RAH=%7.3f [m]\nradius of curvature RAV=%7.3f [m] \n", RAH, RAV);
  
  lambdaI = 2 * PI / kI;
  EI = SI_to_meV * hbar * hbar * kI * kI * 1e20 / 2 / m_n;
  SelFreq = 3956.06 / (lambdaI * (360.0 / (19.7 + (2.1 * tilt))) * 0.25);
  dlambdaI = (1.75004E-05 * pow(lambdaI, 6) - 5.13903E-04 * pow(lambdaI, 5) + 6.04404E-03 * pow(lambdaI, 4) - 3.66989E-02 * pow(lambdaI, 3) + 1.22399E-01 * pow(lambdaI, 2) - 2.19626E-01 * lambdaI + 2.0E-01) * lambdaI;
  
  l_min = lambdaI - dlambdaI;
  l_max = lambdaI + dlambdaI;
  e_min = 81.81 / l_max / l_max;
  e_max = 81.81 / l_min / l_min;
  
  printf("velocity selector frequency is %7.3f [Hz]\n", SelFreq);
  printf("lambda=%7.3f [A]\nkI=%7.3f [A^-1] \nEI=%7.3f [meV]\n", lambdaI, kI, EI);
  printf("Maxwellian source forced to emit only between l_min=%7.3f and l_max=%7.3f [A] in order to save simulation time\n", l_min, l_max);
  printf("correspondingly, the energy monitors at sample position are detecting between %7.3f and %7.3f [meV]\n", e_min, e_max);
  
  beta_guide_1 = LGUIDE_1 / 2800.0 * 180.0 / PI;
  beta_guide_2 = LGUIDE_2 / 2800.0 * 180.0 / PI;
  s_guide_1 = 2800.0 - sqrt(2800.0 * 2800.0 - LGUIDE_1 * LGUIDE_1);
  s_guide_2 = 2800.0 - sqrt(2800.0 * 2800.0 - LGUIDE_2 * LGUIDE_2);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
  AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Gen_Source = Source_gen(
  radius = 0.0775,
  dist = 1.53,
  focus_xw = 0.2,
  focus_yh = 0.125,
  I1 = 1e10,
  T1 = 45,
  Lmin = l_min,
  Lmax = l_max)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT NL1A_NL1B_NL2_NL3_InPile_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 1.530] RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT NL1A_NL1B_NL2_NL3_InPile = Guide(
  w1 = 0.170696,
  h1 = 0.129,
  w2 = 0.340522,
  h2 = 0.129,
  l = 1.870,
  R0 = R0_para,
  Qc = Qc_para,
  alpha = alpha_para,
  m = MGUIDE,
  W = W_para)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1A_NL1B_NL2_NL3_InPile_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Straight1_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [-0.1277, 0, 3.405] RELATIVE Origin
  ROTATION [0, -2.15, 0] RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT NL1B_Straight1 = Guide(
  w1 = 0.06,
  h1 = 0.125,
  w2 = 0.06,
  h2 = 0.125,
  l = 1.549,
  R0 = R0_para,
  Qc = Qc_para,
  alpha = alpha_para,
  m = MGUIDE,
  W = W_para)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Straight1_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Curved_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 1.549] RELATIVE NL1B_Straight1_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Curved_Guide_1 = Guide_curved(
  w1 = 0.06,
  h1 = 0.125,
  l = LGUIDE_1,
  R0 = R0_para,
  Qc = Qc_para,
  alpha = alpha_para,
  m = MGUIDE,
  W = W_para,
  curvature = 2800)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, 0, 180] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Velocity_Selector_Gap_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [-s_guide_1, 0, LGUIDE_1] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, -beta_guide_1, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT Before_selec = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 50,
  ny = 50,
  filename = "PSD_monitor_before.dat",
  xwidth = 0.20,
  yheight = 0.20,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, 0.19] RELATIVE NL1B_Velocity_Selector_Gap_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT SELEC = Selector(
  xmin = -0.0625,
  xmax = 0.0625,
  ymin = -0.03,
  ymax = 0.03,
  length = 0.25,
  nslit = 72,
  d = 0.0004,
  radius = 0.123,
  alpha = 19.7,
  nu = SelFreq)
  AT [0, 0, 0.2] RELATIVE NL1B_Velocity_Selector_Gap_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, tilt, 90] RELATIVE NL1B_Velocity_Selector_Gap_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT After_selec = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 50,
  ny = 50,
  filename = "PSD_monitor_after.dat",
  xwidth = 0.20,
  yheight = 0.20,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, 0.46] RELATIVE NL1B_Velocity_Selector_Gap_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT NL1B_Curved_2_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0.47] RELATIVE NL1B_Velocity_Selector_Gap_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Curved_Guide_2 = Guide_curved(
  w1 = 0.06,
  h1 = 0.125,
  l = LGUIDE_2,
  R0 = R0_para,
  Qc = Qc_para,
  alpha = alpha_para,
  m = MGUIDE,
  W = W_para,
  curvature = 2800)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_2_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, 0, 180] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_2_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Straight2_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [-s_guide_2, 0, LGUIDE_2] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_2_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, -beta_guide_2, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Curved_2_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Straight2 = Guide(
  w1 = 0.06,
  h1 = 0.125,
  w2 = 0.06,
  h2 = 0.125,
  l = 3.500,
  R0 = R0_para,
  Qc = Qc_para,
  alpha = alpha_para,
  m = MGUIDE,
  W = W_para)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Straight2_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Elliptical_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [0.0000, 0, 3.500] RELATIVE NL1B_Straight2_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, 0.000, 0.00] RELATIVE NL1B_Straight2_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT elliptical_piece = Guide_tapering(
  option = "elliptical",
  w1 = 0.06,
  h1 = 0.125,
  l = 2.5,
  linw = 2.9,
  loutw = 0.4,
  R0 = 0.99,
  Qcx = 0.0217,
  Qcy = 0.0217,
  alphax = 4.00,
  alphay = alpha_para,
  W = 0.002,
  mx = 5.2,
  my = MGUIDE,
  segno = 800)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Elliptical_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT Virtual_source = Slit(
  xwidth = wVS,
  yheight = 0.2)
  AT [0, 0, 2.900] RELATIVE NL1B_Elliptical_Entrance_Window
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT NL1B_Vertical_Guide_Entrance_Window = Arm()
  AT [0.0000, 0, 2.925] RELATIVE NL1B_Elliptical_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Vertical_Guide = Guide_channeled(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.125,
  w2 = 0.15,
  h2 = 0.125,
  l = 1.475,
  R0 = R0_para,
  nslit = 1,
  Qcx = Qc_para,
  Qcy = Qc_para,
  alphax = alpha_para,
  alphay = alpha_para,
  W = W_para,
  mx = 0,
  my = MGUIDE)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Vertical_Guide_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT NL1B_Guide_Exit = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 1.475] RELATIVE NL1B_Vertical_Guide_Entrance_Window

COMPONENT energy_endguide = E_monitor(
  nE = 200,
  filename = "energy-endguide.dat",
  xwidth = 0.17,
  yheight = 0.135,
  Emin = e_min,
  Emax = e_max,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Guide_Exit
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Mono_center = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0.25] RELATIVE NL1B_Guide_Exit
  ROTATION [0, A1, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Guide_Exit

COMPONENT Monochromator = Monochromator_curved(
  zwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.02,
  gap = 0.0005,
  NH = 15,
  NV = 7,
  mosaich = 40,
  mosaicv = 40,
  r0 = 1.0,
  t0 = 0.00001,
  RV = RMV,
  RH = RMH)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Mono_center
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Mono_center

COMPONENT Mono_sample_arm = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Mono_center
  ROTATION [0, A2, 0] RELATIVE NL1B_Guide_Exit

COMPONENT energy_mono = E_monitor(
  nE = 200,
  filename = "energy-mono.dat",
  xwidth = 0.2,
  yheight = 0.125,
  Emin = e_min,
  Emax = e_max,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, 0.15] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT energy_pre_sample = E_monitor(
  nE = 50,
  filename = "energy-pre-sample.dat",
  xwidth = 0.08,
  yheight = 0.08,
  Emin = e_min,
  Emax = e_max,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, L2 - 0.1] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Sample_center = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, L2] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm
  ROTATION [0, A3, 0] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm

COMPONENT Sample_analyser_arm = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample_center
  ROTATION [0, A4, 0] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm

COMPONENT div_mono = Divergence_monitor(
  nh = 20,
  nv = 20,
  filename = "div-sample.dat",
  xwidth = 0.1,
  yheight = 0.1,
  maxdiv_h = 4,
  maxdiv_v = 4,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, L2 - 0.05] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT div_mono_H = Div1D_monitor(
  ndiv = 35,
  filename = "H-div-sample.dat",
  xwidth = 0.005,
  yheight = 0.7,
  maxdiv = 4,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, L2 - 0.04] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT psd_sam = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 60,
  ny = 60,
  filename = "psd-sam.dat",
  xwidth = 0.20,
  yheight = 0.20,
  restore_neutron = 1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample_center
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm

COMPONENT dpsd1 = PSDlin_monitor(
  nbins = 30,
  filename = "linpsdsam.dat",
  xmin = -0.1,
  xmax = 0.1,
  ymin = -0.1,
  ymax = 0.1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample_center
  ROTATION [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Mono_sample_arm

END
